<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>EXPLANATORY NOTE </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Amendment No.&nbsp;1 (this &#147;Amendment&#148;) to <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Form&nbsp;8-A</FONT> (the &#147;Registration
Statement&#148;) is being filed pursuant to Section&nbsp;12(b) under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the &#147;Exchange Act&#148;), by The Carlyle Group Inc., a Delaware corporation (&#147;CG&#148;), as the successor registrant to
The Carlyle Group L.P., a Delaware limited partnership (the &#147;Partnership&#148;).&nbsp;Effective at 12:02&nbsp;a.m. (Eastern Time) on January&nbsp;1, 2020, the Partnership converted from a Delaware limited partnership to a Delaware corporation
(the &#147;Conversion&#148;). In accordance with <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Rule&nbsp;12g-3</FONT> under the Exchange Act, upon the effective time of the Conversion, the common stock, par value $0.01 per share (the &#147;Common Stock&#148;),
of CG, was deemed to be registered under Section&nbsp;12(b) of the Exchange Act as CG is deemed to be the successor registrant to the Partnership. CG expressly adopts the Registration Statement, as modified by this Amendment, as its own registration
statement for all purposes of the Exchange Act. The Common Stock will continue to trade on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker symbol &#147;CG.&#148; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Amendment amends the Registration Statement as follows: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

Report on <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Form&nbsp;8-K</FONT> filed on January&nbsp;2, 2020, which is incorporated herein by reference. </P> <P STYLE="font-size:18pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
